verdicts.quote: a Lightning tab named **Grok** (route `/lightning/n/Grok_Bot`) shows the bot page only to users holding the **Grok Bot User** grant.
the bot operation honours the calling user's sharing (it declares sharing), reads only the settings record, creates, changes and deletes no records
It does not read any object that needs object permission or field permission, so there is no CRUD or FLS surface. A reviewer must be able to confirm that statement.
shows the bot page only to users holding the **Grok Bot User** grant. The same grant is required to call the server-side bot operation.
verdicts.missing: Who may administer the bot (edit settings, rotate the key) is left as generic 'admins', not expressed as a permission set or equivalent.

verdicts.quote: Transcript and draft | the page, in browser memory, transient | only that user's browser, never other users
makes at most one callout per call (platform ceiling 100)... the entry takes one conversation and is not reachable from triggers, Flow or batch.
verdicts.missing: The design is deliberately synchronous (AD-5); the callout-after-DML/uncommitted-work rule is not stated as a constraint and no asynchronous mechanism is chosen.

verdicts.quote: the key exists only in the platform credential facility. It never appears in source files, deployed metadata values, the bot settings, any server-side return value, any browser response, any log line
Hard platform limits: one callout per send (≤ 100 per transaction), ≤ 120,000 ms timeout (S-3).
verdicts.missing: Heap size and CPU time limits are not named or quantified.

verdicts.quote: Every failure class and the window rule are testable with a simulated endpoint. The server tests carry a mock that **captures** the outbound request
Named Credential `Grok_xAI`: URL `https://api.x.ai`, Generate Authorization Header off, Allow Formulas in HTTP Header on.
synchronous request and response. An accepted call means a reply or a classified failure, never "pending".
verdicts.missing: The interface relies on the Apex call returning inline; no platform event, polled status or message-channel mechanism is specified.

verdicts.quote: Pending | Send or Enter | ignored, no second callout
Revalidate when: the org shows concurrent-request-limit errors under many simultaneous waits (G-5 observes this)
verdicts.missing: The concurrent-request limit value and what the user sees when a request is rejected by it are not decided.

verdicts.quote: Any other non-2xx status (400, 404, 3xx, 5xx) | `upstream_error` | "Grok is temporarily unavailable. Try again."
verdicts.missing: A 400 refusal and a 5xx failure share one category and message; only 401/403, 429 and timeout are distinct.

verdicts.quote: HTTP 429 | `rate_limited` | "Grok is receiving too many requests right now. Wait a moment and try again." ... No automatic retry exists (A-9).
Read timeout (R-7 timeout elapsed) | `timeout` | "Grok did not answer within the time limit. Try again."
verdicts.missing: A truncated or incomplete answer (e.g. a cut-off reply with text present) is not addressed; only empty/unparseable bodies are.

verdicts.quote: No conversation or usage persistence in Salesforce. The transcript lives in the open page only (R-8).
verdicts.missing: No stored record shape; status, timestamps, model identifier and token/usage counts are not captured anywhere.

verdicts.quote: Refreshing or navigating away discards everything, and nothing is saved in the org.
The outbound call carries only the model id, the system prompt, the windowed conversation and the storage-off flag. It carries no Salesforce user id, name, email, org id or record data.
each send includes the last *E* **completed exchanges** (a user message with its successful reply, *E* = Max history exchanges, default 10) plus the new user message.
If the trimmed text is empty, Send is disabled ... exactly 4000 characters is accepted, 4001 is rejected
An admin can change the model, prompt and limits without code (R-7), can rotate the key in Setup, and can find failures in the debug log by category (R-9).
verdicts.missing: No way for an administrator to turn the bot off is specified.

verdicts.quote: No audit store is added (reason: no persistence is requested).
verdicts.missing: No record of who asked what and what was answered; only category, status and elapsed ms reach the debug log.

verdicts.quote: deploy is validated first (dry run), then applied, with the terminal status and read-back retained.
verdicts.missing: How configuration and credential differ per environment and the production code-coverage requirement are not stated.

verdicts.quote: Answer time is dominated by Grok and has no product target. ... The hard bound is the callout timeout (R-7, ≤ 120,000 ms; default 60,000). ... the pending indicator is visible from Send until the outcome
Designed empty state (greeting plus one hint line), loading state (pending indicator plus "Grok is thinking…"), and error state (R-5 alert that persists until the next Send or Clear
Resources changed by delivery: new metadata only ... Records read, changed or deleted: none. Existing org metadata: observed only, for name-clash checks (G-3).
